html:
Considering having home window tint installed in your home? Our home window tint film is government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality. Below we list the 3M home window tints we offer as part of our home window tinting service.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted window tinting network. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years. Here are the 3M home window tints in our range and the benefits of our home window tinting service:

Our Home Window Tinting Service

Our home window tinting service is conducted by professionally trained installers. We ensure your 3M home window tint is installed properly so it lasts a lifetime and looks fantastic (we offer a lifetime warranty on residential applications). 3M home window tints in our range include:

  • Solar Films
  • Security Films
  • Safety Films
  • Decorative Films

Each of our films offers different benefits. Our solar film reduces heat and glare in your home keeping it at a more constant temperature and helping to eliminate reflections on screens. It also offers protection from harmful UV rays. Because our films provide a layer of insulation, this helps to increase the efficiency of your air conditioning and heating so by having home window tint film installed, you’ll save on your power bills too!

For peace of mind, our security and safety films are stronger than standard film and when hit with force, help to keep shattered glass in place.

Our decorative film is ideal for bathrooms, to use as a divider or to create spaces within your home. Designs can be customised so you can add an element of style to your home.
